claim.quote: The analysis of 73 kg-days of data taken by COSME in a search for solar axions via their photon Primakoff conversion and Bragg scattering in the Ge crystal yields a 95% C.L. limit for the axion-photon coupling g < 2.8 10^-9 GeV^-1.

name: Recent results from the canfranc dark matter search with germanium detectors
notes: Recorded from the proceedings abstract (73 kg d); the full-paper value for 72.7 kg d is in arXiv:hep-ex/0101037.

summary.plain: The COSME germanium crystal also searched for axions made in the Sun, finding none and setting an upper limit on how strongly axions couple to light.
summary.technical: 73 kg d of COSME data analysed for Primakoff conversion with Bragg diffraction in the crystal: 95% C.L. limit g < 2.8e-9 GeV^-1 on the axion-photon coupling (conference proceedings, Dark Matter 2000 workshop).

title: Recent results from the canfranc dark matter search with germanium detectors
why_it_matters: An early crystal-detector axion limit, later improved by the full 72.7 kg d analysis in Astroparticle Physics.
